mainEntity.name: Why does metal-building condensation become severe during Verde Valley winters?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Verde Valley communities like Cottonwood, Clarkdale, and Camp Verde, condensation often spikes during clear winter nights when rapid radiative cooling chills metal roof panels while daytime interior air remains warm. The wide diurnal temperature swings mean warm daytime air traps moisture that suddenly hits dew point after nightfall. An assessment evaluates whether night purging, controlled ventilation, or continuous insulation is the most effective approach for this local climate pattern.
acceptedAnswer.description: Verde Valley winters feature large day-to-night temperature swings, causing warm daytime indoor air to hit its dew point rapidly against metal roof panels on freezing nights.
